summary: Nexus Advanced Technologies Inc., formerly K Wave Media Ltd., furnished a Form 6-K disclosing a corporate name change and Nasdaq ticker change, effective at market open on September 9, 2026; the ordinary shares now trade as NXAT and warrants as NXATWW, replacing KWM and KWMWW. Shareholders authorized the change at the 2026 Annual General Meeting. The rebranding reflects a stated strategic pivot toward AI infrastructure, including potential data-center, AI-compute and GPU investments. No transaction terms, pricing, advisors, board recommendation or regulatory clock are disclosed. The filing is a routine foreign-private-issuer current report, not a special situation; no deal or risk-arb angle arises.
